purpose: Add a source-pinned semantic crosswalk for the official astro-gdt core Rsp2 selection methods. The audit compares the implementation's interval and boundary behavior with the already indexed HOLD-LC-001 segment metadata without reading response coefficients, selecting a production response, fitting a likelihood or changing the established T-054/T-059/T-061 methods.

parent_index.role: R-468 segment metadata and byte-lock output; no raw matrix values are reopened by this audit

drm_index.overlap_mask: Select every index i with tstop[i] > start and tstart[i] < stop (strict overlap).
drm_index.out_of_range: If no index matches, return [0] when stop < tstart[0], otherwise return [num_drms-1].
drm_index.order: Return matching indices in the existing _drms order.

source_semantics.nearest_drm: Delegates atime to drm_index((atime, atime))[0]; despite its docstring, it is not an absolute-distance-to-center argmin in the implementation.
source_semantics.interpolate: Builds scipy.interpolate.interp1d over tcent and response matrices, clamps outside with first/last matrix, and uses nearest_drm only for metadata; matrix values are therefore explicitly outside this audit.
source_semantics.weighted: Uses nearest_drm or interpolate and reads response matrices, then count-weights and normalizes; this path remains locked.

scope.synthetic_doc_mismatch_fixture: Two overlapping intervals [0,20] and [10,30] at query 19; implementation returns first covering index while center-distance argmin returns second.

assumptions: The pinned commit and source-file SHA identify the exact public implementation audited here.
The R-468 primary report remains the authoritative finite segment metadata projection and its SHA is checked before use.
The semantic crosswalk can be evaluated from interval metadata alone; no response coefficient or heap array is required.
The official implementation's scipy dependency and kwargs are not a complete physical calibration-validity contract.
The existing T-054 forward method, T-059 inverse method, T-061 owner order and promotion firewalls remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned validity rule tying each response segment to event and spectral-history windows.
Pinned scipy version and source-owned interpolation domain/kwargs policy if interpolation is ever admitted.
Detector-to-geocenter propagation conversion, common time standard and timing uncertainty.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with a joint likelihood/covariance/nuisance contract.
Complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, immutable scorer and prospective holdout.
evidence_level: T0 exact public source commit/file hash plus finite metadata-only semantic crosswalk
non_claims: This result does not select nearest, covering or interpolation as a production response.
The source implementation's matrix-reading interpolation and weighted paths are not executed or admitted.
The docstring/implementation mismatch and endpoint fallback are software semantics, not a calibration-validity or physical timing law.
No candidate score, holdout prediction, microscopic dynamics, causal propagation, physical sector, Pre-A, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum or mass-gap conclusion follows.
The established T-054 forward and T-059/T-061 observation-first methods are unchanged; this is additive source-owner provenance only.
